note: Re-judged 2026-10-23 (independent auditor, after 5d4afb0c4e), over the cited producer applyRFC7606. The only change to it: the typedNLRIUnparseable branch now resets through rfc7606ResetNotification with MPAttributeErrorNotification(unparseable) instead of rfc7606SessionReset (3/9 with the attribute instead of 3/1). That branch runs only when a typed family's splitter cannot walk an MP NLRI section; it adds no position or combination restriction on Withdrawn Routes, NLRI, MP_REACH_NLRI or MP_UNREACH_NLRI, and the clean path and the per-attribute MP_REACH/MP_UNREACH processing are unchanged. No tagged unit changed. Verdict stands. The earlier independent judgement, carried here unchanged: Independent source rejudgment. RFC 7606 Section 5.1 (rfc/full/rfc7606.txt:423-425): "Since older BGP speakers may not implement these restrictions, an implementation MUST still be prepared to receive these fields in any position or combination." Read the preceding sender restrictions and following legacy-field location paragraph; the positive-only annotation is justified because rejection solely for these shapes would violate the receiver obligation, not be a conforming negative. Read every tagged unit: all four tests in message/rfc7606_section51_receive_test.go and TestRFC7606MPReachIPv4NextHopValid in message/rfc7606_test.go assert exact ActionNone for late MP_UNREACH, distinct MP_REACH plus MP_UNREACH, either MP attribute with legacy NLRI, and late MP_REACH. Read both complete carriers test/plugin/rfc7606-receive-combinations.ci and test/plugin/rfc7606-relay-one-field.ci, plus fixture routeServerReplay13: seeded withdrawals are acknowledged before mixed input, receiver expectations require each component group (and exact legacy withdrawal bytes in relay-one-field), and error-code-specific NOTIFICATION rejection excludes shutdown Cease. Read interop checker internal/le/interoplab/bgp/check_rfc.go::checkRFC7606MixedUpdate: FRR must establish, receive the replay barrier, receive and install 203.0.113.0/24 via the injector, and remain established; its unseeded withdrawn-prefix absence is not independently credited as proof of removal. Producers read: message/rfc7606.go ValidateUpdateRFC7606AddPath walks attributes without a first-position restriction, counts the two MP codes separately, and rejects duplicate instances rather than their combination; reactor/session_validation_receive.go classifyRFC7606 independently locates/validates legacy withdrawn and reachable fields and calls validateRFC7606Attrs; reactor/session_validation.go applyRFC7606 preserves clean input, applies only actual validation outcomes, and does not apply the sender shape restriction. Its typed-NLRI path processes MP_REACH and MP_UNREACH independently. The existing applyRFC7606 code guard is retained. No checks or native discrimination run by this auditor.
